name: University of Malta
summary: Malta's university with fourteen faculties on four campuses, taught in English; it treats the IB Diploma as a local qualification.

ib.text: IB Diploma with 28+ points and 3+ in a language, a science and a humanistic subject, plus Maths, English and Maltese at SEC level (comparable IB subjects may count). Some courses add subjects.

programmes.name: Doctor of Medicine and Surgery
programmes.about: Five years in two parts: two pre-clinical years with dissection labs, then three clinical years on hospital wards. After year 2 you can take a year out for a BSc (Hons) in Medical Sciences before year 3.
programmes.ib: Biology and Chemistry at HL grade 6, plus any other SL subject at 6 (not ESS), all in one sitting. Maltese: a SEC pass or the Medical Maltese course before you start.
programmes.selectionNote: Places are limited; no late applications. The Faculty publishes Biology and Chemistry entrance-exam papers and IB criteria (2026 entry); ask which steps apply to you.
programmes.closesNote: IB applicants without a Maltese SEC pass

flagshipSource.title: Faculty of Medicine & Surgery: 13 departments; two major degrees: the M.D. and Pharmaceutical Science

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering
programmes.about: Four years of mechanics, thermofluids, materials and design, ending in an engineering project. By the end of year 2 you choose a stream: applied materials, applied mechanics and thermofluids, or industrial and manufacturing.
programmes.ib: Maths AA and Physics at HL grade 5 (UM turns its Advanced Level C into IB 5). The general rule also applies: 28 points, and Maltese, English and Maths.

needs.note: UM asks for Pure Mathematics; ask whether AI is accepted

programmes.selectionNote: The page lists no cap and no test: meet the requirements and you qualify..

flagshipSource.title: UM prospectus, Faculty of Engineering: B.Eng. recognised by FEANI; Mechanical Engineering accredited by IMechE and RINA

programmes.name: Information Technology (Artificial Intelligence)
programmes.about: Three years of computer science plus intelligent systems: knowledge management, natural language processing, game AI, web intelligence, adaptive and autonomous systems, and advanced user interfaces, with industry skills throughout.
programmes.ib: Maths AA and Computer Science at grade 5, one at HL and the other at least SL. UM compares IB subjects to its Pure Mathematics and Computing.

needs.note: One of Maths and Computer Science at HL; UM asks for Pure Mathematics
One of Maths and Computer Science at HL

programmes.selectionNote: The page lists no cap and no test: meet the requirements and you qualify. Part-time study is available on request.

flagshipSource.title: Faculty of ICT: set up in 2007; covers AI, computer engineering, computer science, information systems, microelectronics

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts
faculties.line: Most subjects need nothing extra; a language or History needs HL in it, and Fine Arts and Music add a portfolio or audition.

faculties.name: Faculty for the Built Environment
faculties.line: Built Environment Studies asks for the Diploma in Design Foundation Studies plus HL Physics and Maths; Spatial Planning sets no subjects.

faculties.name: Faculty of Dental Surgery
faculties.line: Dental Surgery needs HL Biology and Chemistry and SL Physics; hygiene and technology need Biology or Chemistry. Maltese applies.

faculties.name: Faculty of Economics, Management & Accountancy
faculties.line: Commerce needs Maths; Accountancy also asks for Accounting at Advanced level; Politics and Governance sets no subjects.

faculties.name: Faculty of Education
faculties.line: Early-years teaching asks for one HL subject at grade 5; Maltese and English are checked, and a Police Certificate of Conduct is required.

faculties.name: Faculty of Engineering
faculties.line: Both B.Eng. degrees need Maths and Physics at HL grade 5; the Certificate in Engineering Sciences is the route in without them.

faculties.name: Faculty of Health Sciences
faculties.line: Applied Biomedical Science needs HL Biology and Chemistry and has 24 places; other health degrees list their own subjects.

faculties.name: Faculty of Information & Communication Technology
faculties.line: Every degree needs Maths, most at HL grade 5 with a second subject; the AI degree needs Maths and Computer Science, one at HL.

faculties.name: Faculty of Laws
faculties.line: The LL.B. asks for English and Maltese at HL grade 5 and three SL subjects; Maltese is named,.

faculties.name: Faculty of Media & Knowledge Sciences
faculties.line: Most areas set no subject; Communication Studies wants English, Fine Arts a portfolio interview, and Music an interview and audition.

faculties.name: Faculty of Medicine & Surgery
faculties.line: The M.D. needs HL Biology and Chemistry at 6 and Maltese; Pharmaceutical Science and Medical Biochemistry are other degrees.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science
faculties.line: Each area names its subjects: Maths HL for Computing Science, Biology and Chemistry for Biology, Physics and Maths for Physics.

faculties.name: Faculty for Social Wellbeing
faculties.line: Its degrees, including Criminology, list only the general entry rule; adult-learner routes differ.

faculties.name: Faculty of Theology
faculties.line: Theology, Philosophy and Disability Studies set no subjects; the Mathematics area needs HL Maths.

notes: HL subjects normally meet a MATSEC Advanced Level requirement and SL an Intermediate one; 7, 6, 5, 4 IB points equal grades A, B, C, D, and ab initio subjects never count.

For October 2027 entry, a non-Maltese applicant with under four years of secondary schooling in Malta may offer another language at SEC level 3 or grade 5 in place of Maltese, unless a course names Maltese.
The IB counts as a local qualification: the application fee is €35 (€75 late), course pages show "No fees apply" for EU/EEA students, and Medicine and capped courses take no late applications.
